headline: Updates on cemetery erosion, stone restoration, business fundraising, and burial law discussions for city-owned cemeteries.
summary: The committee will review reports on Langsford erosion, Josiah Choate stone restoration, and tax-exempt donation status, plus discuss a Senate bill on burial alternatives and new business.
